messages:
juno-sales: Valence asked for an exec-level timeline and unblock today. Blockers: SSO (SAML + SCIM), EU-only pilot, and a one-time pilot discount.

max-se: We support SAML 2.0. For a quick test we need IdP metadata + two test users + allowlist for our EU test IPs. Can spin up a feature-flagged SP endpoint in EU.

hana-infra: EU-only Dedicated trial possible. Lead time ~48-72h after approval. Cost estimate: 2,700/week. Need capacity ticket.

juno-sales: Customer requested 30% off pilot fees for 6 weeks. What's the approval path?

tara-legal: Any >20% concession needs Deal Desk signoff and VP approval. Post ARR and term here and I'll route.

liam-cs: Valence wants logs kept <30 days and no export outside EU during pilot. Confirm with infra.

evelyn-cust: We can provide metadata today, want test window asap.

max-se: Test plan:
```
1) Upload IdP metadata to SP
2) SP-initiated login with test user
3) SCIM provisioning check (email, name, groups)
4) Confirm group-based access
```

hana-infra: Ticket DP-812 created for Dedicated pilot. Provision ETA 60h.

tara-legal: Please post ARR and pilot term. I'll prepare amendment and kick Deal Desk.

juno-sales: ARR estimate: 2,000 ARR (projected). Pilot term: 6 weeks. I'll push for decision by Fri COB and drop a 1-pager for execs here.

pagerbot: Reminder: DP-812 status changed to queued.

max-se: Ping me when metadata + accounts are posted, I'll run the SAML test and bring SRE. :thumbsup:
